name: Accordion / Account Settings
description: Account Settings product scenario for the Accordion component.

items.label: Profile and workspace
items.content: Company details, workspace identity, and member preferences.

items.label: Security
items.content: Single sign-on, sessions, and recovery policies.

controls.name: items
controls.description: Ordered section definitions with unique string values.

controls.name: icon
controls.description: Default decorative icon at the start of each trigger; item.icon overrides it.

controls.name: expandedIds
controls.description: Controlled section values; absent items are retained for asynchronous lists.

controls.name: defaultExpandedIds
controls.description: Initial uncontrolled section values; later changes are ignored.

controls.name: multiple
controls.description: Allow multiple open sections; false displays the first available expanded value.

controls.name: collapsible
controls.description: Allow users to collapse the last visible open section; does not auto-open a section.

controls.name: disabled
controls.description: Disable all disclosure triggers; panel contents keep their own interactivity.

controls.name: headingLevel
controls.description: Heading level for section triggers in the containing document.
